headline: BlackRock Investment Institute moves U.S. equities to neutral, short-term U.S. Treasuries to overweight

changes.rationale: Manage potential volatility around AI infrastructure buildout
Rate hike expectations viewed as overdone

context: BlackRock Investment Institute closed a long-held U.S. equity overweight view and unwound a Treasury underweight maintained for much of the prior six years.
does_not_establish: BlackRock executed a quantified sale of U.S. equities
BlackRock or another institution manipulated SPY prices
A direct causal link between this commentary and intraday SPY price movements
market_relevance: Documented change in a major research institution's relative asset-class preference; may be compared with fund flows, ETF issuance and SPY price data without assuming execution.
